_about: Map model for site/public/index.html. Edited by hand; tools/build_map_data.py merges it with integrations/integration-register.yaml into build/map.json, which is uploaded to the private Supabase bucket. Never deploy this file. Node `integrations` are register IDs (shown by name) or free text; `docs` paths are pack files linked from docs_base. The build fails if an interface number would be shown.

header.lede: Many systems originate transactions, many Oracle modules record them, and everything narrows into one accounting engine and one ledger family. Select any system to see what it does, how it connects and where to read more.

p2p.title: Procure to Pay: eight stages
p2p.lede: Zip orchestrates, Oracle decides. The first four stages move a commitment without touching the ledger. Receipts not yet invoiced are accrued at period end; invoice and payment create accounting through Subledger Accounting under CORP_GAAP_SLAM. Settlement changes status only: bank outcomes return hourly and a rejected payment is voided manually.

stages.title: Supplier onboarding
stages.system: Apex + supplier interface · Oracle registration + completion interface
points: PO suppliers: the supplier completes questionnaires, risk, bank and tax details in the Apex portal
An interface creates or updates the Oracle supplier every 30 minutes: profile, addresses, sites, bank accounts, tax
Non-PO, ad hoc and Treasury payees: internal Oracle registration request, approved, then completed by an interface
Sites are created per company code from the enterprise-structure crosswalk

stages.title: Intake
points: Requester submits the purchase request in Zip: spend category, legal entity, cost center
Conditional reviews: third-party risk, data privacy, legal, BizTech, sustainability
Zip proposes the accounting segments from lookup tables kept in step with Oracle
Approved request is sent to Oracle as a requisition

stages.title: Requisition
points: Requisition arrives in Self-Service Procurement with the proposed accounting
Oracle re-derives the charge account; requisition validations and cross-validation rules run at submit
Approval routed by cost center
First point in SOX scope

stages.title: Purchase order
points: Approved requisition becomes a purchase order; buyer review in Oracle
Change orders handled by Procurement Ops
Bulk updates loaded by file import for volume changes
No accounting at PO approval

stages.title: Receipt
points: Goods or services are received against the PO: the third leg of the three-way match
The receipt itself creates no accounting: expense items accrue at period end
At period close, receipts without invoices are accrued; the accrual reverses when the next period opens
Consumption-based spend is accrued by a variable-accrual interface; a not-reversed alert catches missed reversals
Accrual sync and FX variation reports track open accruals

entries.event: Period end: receipts not yet invoiced

stages.title: Invoice
points: Invoices arrive from the AP desk, legal e-billing, ad hoc payment requests and Oracle Expenses
Matched to PO and receipt within tolerances held per business unit; exceptions go on hold
Zip-approved payment-terms exceptions applied; non-PO invoices over 5K held for review
Validated invoices become payable

dr: Expense (PO charge account) or Asset clearing
cr: Withholding tax (liability), if withheld at validation

stages.title: Payment
points: Validated invoices selected into a payment process request per legal entity and bank account
One payment file per bank sent to Kyriba over SFTP; standard payments auto-approve in Kyriba
Urgent and one-time payments go through the Urgent Payment Tool and are released by Treasury
Accounting is booked once, at issue, straight to Cash, in the primary and STAT secondary ledgers

stages.title: Settlement
points: Kyriba maps the payment to the bank's code and format and transmits host-to-host
Bank acknowledgements return hourly and are recorded on the Oracle payment
Rejected payments are voided manually in Oracle
Daily bank statements reconcile each payment from Negotiable to Cleared: a status change only, no journal entry

notes.title: Spend category → code combination.
notes.text: Zip proposes segments through three chained lookups. Oracle re-derives the charge account, applies requisition validations and cross-validation rules, and stores the result. A mis-posting has two possible homes: compare what Zip sent with what Oracle stored.

p2p.accounting_note: Expense items accrue at period end: receipts without invoices are accrued at close and reversed when the next period opens, and the invoice books the expense. Payments are accounted once, at issue, straight to Cash; there is no cash clearing account, so bank acknowledgement and statement reconciliation create no journal entry. Entries post to the primary ledger and its STAT secondary ledger.

onboarding.title: Two paths into the supplier master
onboarding.lede: PO suppliers are onboarded through Apex and arrive in Oracle through the Apex supplier interface. Non-PO, ad hoc and Treasury payees are created in Oracle through the Supplier Registration Request and completed by an interface. Both land in the same supplier master.

lanes.route: Zip → Apex → INT · Apex suppliers to Oracle → Oracle

steps.text: Supplier completes questionnaires, risk, bank and tax detail; status Pending ERP

steps.text: Create or update by ERP Unique ID; banks and branches first; sites per company code from the enterprise-structure crosswalk

steps.label: Feedback to Apex
steps.text: Oracle IDs back per record; errors to the Apex event log

lanes.title: Non-PO, ad hoc and Treasury payees

steps.label: Supplier Registration Request
steps.text: Internal Redwood form and questionnaire; six pages, bank accounts on page 5

steps.label: Internal registration approval
steps.text: Separate approval task from external registration

steps.label: INT · Supplier completion
steps.text: Completes profile, payment methods and tax flags from the questionnaire

notes.title: Crosswalk dependency.
notes.text: A new legal entity needs a row in the company-code crosswalk, or the Apex supplier interface cannot create a supplier site for it.

notes.title: In flight on the SRR path.
notes.text: Address required at submission, selected payment method as default with others kept active, Tax Type and TRN/DUNS requiredness under analysis.

notes.title: Return legs.
notes.text: Two return interfaces send Oracle-side supplier changes back to Apex.

close.title: The close runs on a calendar, not on events
close.lede: Nineteen-plus feeders converge into GL, which then feeds FCCS, ARCS, planning and the warehouse on their own clocks. Most apparent system dependencies are sequencing dependencies.

integrations.title: Integration register
integrations.lede: A strong sample assembled from production monitoring names and design documents, not a certified register. The lane a flow sits in tells you who operates it and where a failure surfaces.
